files.title: File:Pomeroy Post Office, 2nd Street, Pomeroy, OH - 53040465957.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1939, this Colonial Revival-style building was designed by Louis A. Simon to serve as a United States Post Office for Pomeroy, Ohio.  The building features a red brick exterior, nine-over-nine double-hung windows, a side-gable roof, a front stoop with two long flights of stairs to either side, rusticated brick at the base, fanlight windows at the gable ends, a loading dock at one end of the building, and a front entrance bay in the center of the front facade with a fanlight transom.
